title: Integral generic ideal lattice construction
statement: For an integral Noetherian scheme Z and coherent module G, there exist r and an ideal sheaf I, both I and the coproduct of r copies of I coherent, and a morphism χ from that coproduct to G whose generic stalk map is an isomorphism.

proof.text: The generic local ring of an integral scheme is a field and the generic stalk of a coherent module is finite dimensional. Choose a basis and extend the induced free-module map to a neighbourhood of the generic point using coherent_stalk_map_extends, then shrink so it is an isomorphism by coherent_local_isomorphism.

Give the closed complement of that neighbourhood its reduced induced structure. The extension-over-an-open lemma supplies a power of its ideal and a map from a finite coproduct of copies of that ideal which agrees with the free-module map on the neighbourhood. The ideal and coproduct are coherent by local Noetherianity, and the generic stalk map is an isomorphism.

mathlib_searches.query: coherent ideal sum generic stalk isomorphism

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_integral_generic_ideal_construction (Z : Scheme.{w}) [IsNoetherian Z]
    [IsIntegral Z] (G : Z.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace G) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (I : Z.IdealSheafData),
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace I.toModules ∧
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules) ∧
      ∃ (χ : (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules) ⟶ G),
        IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace (genericPoint Z)).map χ)
